verdict.rationale: `ultrametric init --dry-run` previews which skill files will be created before anything is written, and a hands-on probe confirmed it listed both SKILL.md targets (.agents/skills and .claude/skills) without writing them. The skills are then written as plain local project files that can be committed and shared, so every file can be read and reviewed afterward. missing for 10: evidence that the dry-run shows file contents rather than just paths, explicit documentation that installed skills are fully inspectable, clarity on whether any scripts (beyond SKILL.md instructions) are added, independent corroboration.
